page.overview:
Who is Dance Fever?

Dance Fever is a male background Earth pony who appears in Hearts and Hooves Day and Slice of Life. He has a tan coat, two-tone brown mane, light blue eyes, and a cutie mark of a disco ball. He is unnamed in the show, but he is named in merchandise.

Dance Fever has a handlebar mustache and chest hair, and he wears aviator sunglasses, a sparkling green collared shirt, and a brown belt with a golden belt buckle. He shares his body type with Prince Blueblood, "Hay Fever", "Persnickety", and "Bushel" and his color scheme with Dr. Hooves and Crescent Moon.

In season five, Dance Fever appears in Slice of Life. DJ Pon-3 and Octavia Melody pick him, Button Mash, and Hughbert Jellius up on their way to Cranky Doodle Donkey and Matilda's wedding, and he watches the ceremony in Ponyville Town Hall.

Dance Fever, under the name "Flashy Pony", is a playable character in Gameloft's mobile game, added in the version 1.2 update on February 28, 2013. His bio description states, "Flashy Pony is just that, with his handlebar mustache, sunglasses, and sparkling green shirt."
